timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I think some people are leaders by nature, but the scouting you can help people to become good leaders.
You can pull forward good values in a boy or in a girl and help to understand what leadership is and is always about interaction between people and to understand people.
I would like to find the real heroes in this really society, the young people, and show to other young people that these are the real heroes and who does something extraordinary for the society.
